name: Exp_Ergodic_Ticks_Volume_Indicator
summary: This EA trades based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume Indicator, which is a momentum oscillator derived from tick volume data smoothed through multiple averaging layers. It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable position closing on signal reversals.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Ergodic Tick成交量指标进行交易，该指标是通过多层平滑算法处理tick成交量数据得出的动量振荡器。当指标线上穿信号线时开多仓，下穿信号线时开空仓，并可在信号反转时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Ergodic Tick成交量指标，这是一种利用tick成交量数据经过六层平滑处理（XLength1-XLength6）构建的动量振荡器，类似于MACD但基于成交量而非价格。入场条件为：当指标线（Ind）上穿信号线（Sign）时开多仓，当指标线下穿信号线（Sign）时开空仓，仅在信号交叉发生的新K线或SignalBar指定的K线上触发。出场条件包括：多仓在指标线跌破信号线时平仓，空仓在指标线上穿信号线时平仓，同时支持固定点数的止损（StopLoss_=1000）和止盈（TakeProfit_=2000）。仓位管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），并支持多种资金管理模式（MMMode），包括基于自由保证金、余额、损失后保证金和固定手数等模式。资金管理依赖于TradeAlgorithms.mqh中封装的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数，结合偏差控制（Deviation_=10）来管理滑点风险。策略使用新K线检测机制（IsNewBar）避免重复信号，但缺乏对持仓量的检查、点差过滤和追加止损机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Ergodic Ticks Volume Indicator, a momentum oscillator constructed from tick volume data processed through six smoothing layers (XLength1-XLength6), similar to MACD but volume-based rather than price-based. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the indicator line (Ind) crosses above the signal line (Sign), and a sell position opens when the indicator line crosses below the signal line, triggered only on new bars or the bar specified by SignalBar. Exit conditions include closing buy positions when the indicator drops below the signal line and closing sell positions when the indicator rises above the signal line, with configurable fixed stop-loss (StopLoss_=1000) and take-profit (TakeProfit_=2000). Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1) with multiple money management modes (MMMode) including free margin-based, balance-based, loss-adjusted margin-based, and fixed lot sizing. Money management relies on BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, with deviation control (Deviation_=10) to manage slippage risk. The strategy uses a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to avoid duplicate signals, but lacks position count checks, spread filters, and trailing stop mechanisms.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例，控制每笔交易的风险占比

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 手数计算模式：自由保证金/余额/损失后余额/固定手数
parameters.description_en: Margin calculation mode (fixed lots/balance/free margin etc.)

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description: 成交量类型：Tick成交量或真实成交量
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑相位参数（JJMA: -100~+100, VIDYA/AMA适用）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于获取信号的历史K线索引

pros: 基于成交量的动量指标，比纯价格指标提供更深层的市场信息
六层平滑架构和多种平滑算法选择，使指标适应性极强
买卖开平仓可独立控制，灵活性高，便于只做多或只做空
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线重复交易
支持多种资金管理模式，适合不同风险偏好的交易者
pros_en: Volume-based momentum indicator provides deeper market insight than pure price indicators
Six-layer smoothing architecture with multiple smoothing algorithm choices offers high adaptability
Buy/sell open and close can be independently controlled, providing flexibility for long-only or short-only strategies
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same bar
Multiple money management modes suit traders with different risk preferences
cons: 缺乏持仓数量检查，可能在已有同向持仓时重复开仓
没有点差过滤器，在高点差环境下信号可能失真导致不利成交
止损止盈为固定点数，不根据市场波动性（如ATR）动态调整
信号反转即平仓且新信号即开仓，在震荡市中容易频繁进出造成亏损
依赖外部指标文件Ergodic_Ticks_Volume_Indicator，若该文件缺失则EA无法运行
cons_en: No position count check, may open duplicate positions in the same direction when one already exists
No spread filter, signals may be distorted in high-spread environments leading to unfavorable fills
Stop-loss and take-profit are fixed pip values, not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility (e.g., ATR)
Signal reversal triggers close and new signals trigger open, causing frequent whipsaw trades in ranging markets
Depends on external indicator file Ergodic_Ticks_Volume_Indicator, EA fails if the file is missing
improvements: 增加最大持仓数量限制和同向持仓检查，避免重复开仓导致过度杠杆
加入点差过滤和ATR动态止损止盈，适应不同市场波动环境
improvements_en: Add maximum position count limit and same-direction position check to avoid over-leveraging from duplicate entries
Add spread filter and ATR-based dynamic stop-loss/take-profit to adapt to different market volatility environments

risk_points: 无持仓数量检查，可能在同方向连续开仓导致过度暴露
固定止损止盈不适应市场波动变化，在低波动时止盈过远、高波动时止损过近
成交量指标在流动性差的市场中信号可能不可靠
risk_points_en: No position count check may lead to over-exposure from consecutive same-direction entries
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not adapt to market volatility changes, making TP too far in low volatility and SL too close in high volatility
Volume-based indicator signals may be unreliable in low-liquidity markets

It opens buy positions when the indicator line crosses above the signal line and sell positions when it crosses below, with configurable position closing on signal reversals.
